title: In silico and in vitro evaluation of potential agonistic and antagonistic estrogenic and androgenic activities of pure cyanotoxins, microcystin-LR and cylindrospermopsin.
authors: Casas-Rodriguez, Antonio; Cascajosa-Lira, Antonio; Puerto, Maria; Camean, Ana Maria; Jos, Angeles
one_liner_zh: 该文通过体外实验和分子对接评估蓝藻毒素对雌激素/雄激素受体的激动/拮抗活性，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子毒素与核受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The potential endocrine disruption activity of cyanotoxins, particularly their effects on estrogen and androgen receptors (ER, AR), remains poorly understood. In the present study, the potential agonistic/antagonistic estrogenic and androgenic activities of MC-LR and CYN have been determined for the first time with validated OECD Test Guidelines No. 455 and 458, respectively. The data show that only MC-LR demonstrated weak estrogenic agonistic effects (LogPC(10) value of -9.85 M), while both toxins displayed antagonistic effects on the ER, with LogIC(30) values of -4.4 and -6.4 for MC-LR and CYN, respectively. In addition, neither MC-LR nor CYN exhibited agonistic/antagonistic activities in AR. Docking studies revealed potential interactions between both toxins and AR, with CYN showing a higher predicted affinity for this receptor. In vivo studies, particularly those investigating androgen disruption, are warranted to confirm the endocrine disrupting potential of MC-LR and CYN.
abstract_zh: 蓝藻毒素潜在的内分泌干扰活性，特别是其对雌激素和雄激素受体（ER, AR）的影响，仍知之甚少。本研究首次采用经验证的OECD测试指南第455号和458号，分别测定了MC-LR和CYN的潜在激动/拮抗雌激素和雄激素活性。数据显示，仅MC-LR表现出微弱的雌激素激动效应（LogPC(10)值为-9.85 M），而两种毒素均对ER表现出拮抗效应，MC-LR和CYN的LogIC(30)值分别为-4.4和-6.4。此外，MC-LR和CYN在AR中均未表现出激动/拮抗活性。对接研究揭示了两种毒素与AR之间的潜在相互作用，其中CYN对该受体显示出更高的预测亲和力。需要进行体内研究，特别是探讨雄激素干扰的研究，以确认MC-LR和CYN的内分泌干扰潜力。
